title: ID0384585-DC/Si-D/AT[EP1uND & NNNKEW] - FW Update stuck
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
FW update stuck and Screensaver not uploaded correctly
Root cause:
Swupdate stuck and RETOPICs hotfix needed
Solution:
Restart swupdate service & install the RETOPICS hotfix
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:
Siemens
Warranty Status:
Active
